entries.title: Counting magnetic flux quanta offers new way to measure photon numbers
entries.summary: Researchers at AIST have directly observed magnetic flux quanta generated in a superconductor by photon absorption and demonstrated a new principle of photon detection that identifies the number of photons based on the number of these flux quanta.

entries.title: Plain silicon grating reveals a hidden 'twist' in light from electron beams
entries.summary: In 1953, two physicists showed that an electron beam skimming past a grating emits light whose color depends only on the electron's speed and the grating's spacing. Known as Smith-Purcell radiation, this phenomenon has become a useful tool for building compact, tunable light…
